description: Aisha Steel Mills Limited, a group company of Arif Habib, was incorporated in 2005 and began commercial production in 2012. It runs a cold rolling mill complex and a galvanising plant in the downstream industrial estate at Pakistan Steel, Bin Qasim, Karachi, making cold rolled and hot dipped galvanised steel coils for the value-added flat-rolled steel market.
headOffice: 1/F, Arif Habib Center, 23 M.T. Khan Road, Karachi
